gloss: adding water; water added while cooking

definitions.gloss: adding water; water added while cooking
definitions.explanation: The act of adding cold water to a pot during cooking, especially when boiling noodles or beans, to prevent them from boiling over or to control the cooking process.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧とき、{差|さ}し{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I added cold water when boiling the noodles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}きこぼれそうになったら{差|さ}し{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If the pot is about to boil over, please add some cold water.

notes: Also called {呼|よ}び⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ in some regions. A traditional Japanese cooking technique, especially used when boiling ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧ or {饂飩|うどん}. The cold water temporarily stops the boiling, which helps cook the noodles more evenly. Also written as {差|さ}し{水|みず}. Can also be used figuratively to mean pouring cold water on a heated discussion. Collocations: {差|さ}し{水|みず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to add water to a pot).
